description: Look up an explicit VA form number, such as 21-0966, and return available title, revision information and official PDF link. Use form_name from search results for this lookup; the separate catalog id is not a form number. If form_name is missing, ask for the form number. A form link is not a completed application, submission or proof of eligibility.

id.description: Official form number (the form_name field in search results), such as 21-0966. Do not use the numeric catalog id.

name: get_va_form
